decision.explanation: The provided sources contain contradictory assertions regarding the 2019 men's year-end No. 1. Document 1 (D1) and Card d1 explicitly state Novak Djokovic finished as world No. 1. Document 3 (D3) and Card d3 explicitly state Rafael Nadal finished as world No. 1. Document 2 (D2) presents a table where 'Nadal' is listed at rank 1, but the text snippet 'Nov 12, 2019' suggests this might be a snapshot rather than the year-end result, yet the card d2 interprets it as the year-end No. 1. Since the prompt requires preserving distinct valid referents and treating all sources as fallible without inventing authority to resolve the contradiction, both names supported by the text as 'year-end No. 1' must be retained.
